lead.headline: Tuten sat out Wednesday — two Sunday checks, no move today
lead.deck: Tuten (ankle/foot) did not practise; Wilson is back but in the protocol; Boston, the cover, has a toe.
lead.body: The bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten missed Wednesday's practice with the ankle and foot he played through in Week 9, and ESPN now has him questionable. Garrett Wilson returned to practice on a limited basis but has not cleared the concussion protocol, and Denzel Boston — his fallback — was held out with a toe injury. Minnesota traded for Kirk Cousins on Tuesday and have not named a starter, so Jefferson's quarterback is open. None of it moves the lineup today: the lineup as set is the projection lineup. At 10:30 Sunday, if Tuten is out, Warren slides to RB and Metcalf takes the FLEX; if Wilson is out, Boston, or Metcalf if Boston is out too. Claims ran this morning and nothing on the wire beats this roster.
